name: Asahi Sakura
source:
[spoiler]Name: Sakura Asahi
Sex: Female
Age: 29
Birthday: April 11
Profession: Ex-Medical Technology Researcher
Likes: Round Things, Fluffy Things, CUTE Things, Harajuku
Dislikes: Things that are bad for Hina, Pollen, Natural Remedies
Hobbies: Collecting cutesy things
Skills: Testing viruses, Instantly finding Hina's location

Sakura protected [url=/c151122]Hina[/url] from a violent assault and became bedridden, living in a state of minimal consciousness.

[From the in-game character description][/spoiler]

She fell into a coma 6 years ago, but went missing soon after. [spoiler]She was taken by Hina and her consciousness was duplicated to an AI: [url=/c151123]Akemi[/url].[/spoiler]
